results.title: OpenBot: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer | Product Hunt
results.content:
Before that: IBM, and trading.  
  
What is OpenBot   
OpenBot is a free, open-source alternative to Grok Bot - a team of AI agents that runs locally on your own computer instead of cloud. Plug in the ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or OpenCode subscription you already have, no extra bill.   
It also has a multiplayer mode, so your whole team can share a project and talk to the same agents together, live.  
  
The problem   
Grok Bot showed where AI is headed - agents that work for you. But it runs on a Linux server in the cloud: plenty of apps just don't work there, websites often flag and block that kind of server traffic outright, it costs $200-300/month on top of what you already pay, and there's no way for a team to actually work with the same agents together.

Promoted [...] OpenBot runs entirely on your own machine - no cloud server, no Linux restrictions, no blocked apps or websites
 Works with the ChatGPT, Claude, Grok and OpenCode subscription you already have - no extra bill
 Multiplayer: share a project and your whole team talks to the same agents together, live - something Grok Bot doesn't have yet
 Fully open source - the code is public, so anyone can verify it, contribute to it, or run it themselves
 Pick from ready-made agents to get started instantly, or build your own from scratch
 Run multiple specialist agents in parallel, each with its own memory - they hand off tasks to each other automatically
 Agents handle everyday tasks on their own, and only stop to ask you before anything irreversible - like sending a message or spending money
